method: Reviewed from class_rights_passages_2024-12-31.json (10-K/10-Q filed on or before as_of). The gate chain re-verifies every quote verbatim in the stored filing, the filing date, the CIK, and the ratio wording; unverified issuers stay lower-bound blockers.
formula: economic-equivalent listed shares = listed class shares + sum(ratio x unlisted class shares); PIT market cap = equivalent shares x listed class as-of close (x post-as_of split factor via the chain's price basis)

CommonClassBMember.rights_summary: Class B = shares of Hyatt Hotels Corp itself (10 votes/share), converted share-for-share into Class A; same per-share cash dividend as Class A.

citations.quote: Class B Share Conversion —During the years ended December 31, 2023, December 31, 2022, and December 31, 2021, 160,626 shares, 735,522 shares, and 2,385,647 shares, respectively, of Class B common stock were converted on a share-for-share basis into shares of Class A common stock, $ 0.

0001468174.double_count_check: No operating-partnership units: Class A and Class B are both issued shares of the registrant; the cover counts are separate classes (Class B converted shares are retired), so A + B is not double counted.

CommonClassBMember.rights_summary: Class B (1 vote, no dividends, no liquidation rights) is held with an equal number of TKO OpCo Common Units by Endeavor; units (+ equal Class B) redeemable for cash or, at the company's option, Class A one-for-one; the Class B share is cancelled on exchange.

citations.quote: TKO OpCo’s operating agreement provides that holders of membership interests in TKO OpCo (“Common Units”) may, from time to time, require TKO OpCo to redeem all or a portion of their Common Units (and an equal number of shares of TKO Class B common stock) for cash or, at the Company’s option, for shares of TKO Class A common stock on a one-for-one basis.

Holders of TKO Class B common stock are not entitled to receive dividends and will not be entitled to receive any distributions upon the liquidation, dissolution or winding up of the affairs of the Company.

0001973266.double_count_check: Class B carries no economic rights; the economic interest is the equal number of TKO OpCo Common Units held by non-TKO members (10-K: 89,616,891 Class B = units held by Endeavor entities; 10-Q cover Class B 89,616,891). Counting Class B count x 1 counts each exchangeable unit once; TKO's own OpCo units are represented by Class A.

CommonClassBMember.rights_summary: Class B (10 votes, no dividend or liquidation rights) is held in equal number by holders of Ryan Specialty LLC Common Units other than the Company; units are exchangeable for Class A one-for-one (or cash at the Company's election, from a secondary offering).

citations.quote: Future transfers by the holders of LLC Common Units (who own an equal number of 10 votes per share Class B common stock related thereto) will generally result in those shares converting into shares of Class A common stock and the cancellation of the related Class B common stock, subject to limited exceptions, such as certain transfers effected for estate planning or charitable purposes.

The non-controlling interest holders may, subject to certain exceptions, exchange some or all of their LLC Common Units for newly-issued shares of Class A common stock on a one-for-one basis, or for cash, at the Company’s election (determined by a majority of the Company’s directors who are disinterested) and only to the extent that the Company has received cash proceeds pursuant to a secondary offering.
Each LLC Unitholder, other than the Company, has an equivalent number of shares of our Class B common stock which are entitled to 10 votes per share.
Holders of Class B common stock do not have any right to receive dividends or distributions upon the liquidation or winding up of the Company.

0001849253.double_count_check: Class B count (136,670,204 on the 10-Q cover) = LLC Common Units held by unitholders other than the Company ('Each LLC Unitholder, other than the Company, has an equivalent number of shares of our Class B common stock'); the Company's own units match its Class A shares one-to-one (New LLC Operating Agreement), so A + B counts each economic unit once.

CommonClassBMember.rights_summary: Class B (10 votes, unlisted) is Dick's Sporting Goods' own stock, convertible one-for-one into the listed common stock at any time at the holder's option; dividends are paid per share of common and Class B.

citations.quote: Shares of our Class B common stock can be converted on a one-for-one basis to shares of our common stock at any time at the holder’s option and are automatically converted upon the occurrence of certain events.
Each share of Class B common stock can be converted at any time into one share of common stock at the holder’s option.

0001089063.double_count_check: No operating-partnership units: common (XBRL CommonClassAMember, 57,903,976) and Class B (23,570,633) are both issued shares of the registrant (10-Q cover 2024-11-22); A + B is not double counted. Listed member per symbol_mappings (10-K: Class B 'not listed or traded').
